candidate.text:
If you have configured `-boltdb.shipper.shared-store.key-prefix` or its YAML setting to a value other than `index/`, ensure that all the existing period configs that use `boltdb-shipper` as the index have `path_prefix` set to the value previously configured.
- restated: If you have configured `-tsdb.shipper.shared-store.key-prefix` or its YAML setting to a value other than `index/`, ensure that all the existing period configs that use `tsdb` as the index have the `path_prefix` set to the value previously configured.
